variants.title: Match an index to a query
variants.context: MySQL indexes help locate rows. A composite index orders multiple key parts.
variants.prompt: Frequent queries filter by tenant_id and short_code. Which index is a candidate to evaluate?
options: An index on created_at when no time filter is used.
A destination-only index for these tenant/code queries.
variants.hint: Start with the fields and ordering used by the query.

variants.context: MySQL indexes help locate rows. A composite index orders multiple key parts.
variants.prompt: A composite index is on (tenant_id, created_at). Which lookup directly uses its leftmost key?

variants.title: Budget index storage
variants.context: Indexes consume storage in addition to the base records. This simplified estimate assumes a fixed number of bytes per index entry.
variants.prompt: 1000000 rows each add 40 bytes to an index. Ignoring overhead, how many decimal MB does the index add?
variants.hint: Use row count × bytes per entry.

mistakes.feedback: That is the byte total. Divide by 1,000,000 to reach decimal MB.
That stops at kilobytes. Divide by 1,000,000, not 1,000.

variants.title: Order a transactional update
variants.context: A transaction groups work so the application can check constraints and commit a valid result.
variants.prompt: Create an order and its line items as one transaction.

items.text: Insert the order and its valid line items.
Confirm the order to the caller.

variants.hint: Tie acknowledgment to the committed outcome, not an intermediate write.
variants.explanation: Confirm only after the durable transactional outcome is known.

variants.title: Order a transactional update
variants.context: A transaction groups work so the application can check constraints and commit a valid result.
variants.prompt: A statement fails before commit. Order the response.

items.text: Report that the operation did not complete.

variants.hint: Tie acknowledgment to the committed outcome, not an intermediate write.
variants.explanation: Do not acknowledge a partially applied business operation as a success.

variants.title: Order a transactional update
variants.context: A transaction groups work so the application can check constraints and commit a valid result.
variants.prompt: A deadlock aborts a transaction that can safely be retried. Order the response.

items.text: Restart the complete transaction with bounded retries.
Confirm success only after a successful commit.

variants.hint: Tie acknowledgment to the committed outcome, not an intermediate write.
variants.explanation: A retry must repeat the logical transaction and remain bounded.
